'''Stones Falling Down the Mountain''' is a [[sword form]]. Aside from the name, nothing is known about it. [[Rand al'Thor]] used [[Unfolding the Fan]] to counter this form when he was attacked by [[bubble of evil|duplicate reflections]] of himself in the [[Stone of Tear]].{{ref/book|4|2}}

==See also==
* [[Stone Falls From the Mountain]], a sword form with a similar name.
